summary: Circumstantial evidence sufficiency in murder; standards for proving guilt beyond reasonable doubt; conviction under IPC 302 upheld; concurrent findings given primacy; recovery of blood-stained clothes deemed unreliable; compromise with deceased in prior 498A case irrelevant to subsequent murder; periods of alleged cruelty re-evaluated; dismissal of appeal with restoration of life sentence.
legal_provisions_cited: Sharda Birdhichand Sarda v. State of Maharashtra
Hanumant v. State of Madhya Pradesh
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction under Section 302 IPC upheld; life sentence restored.
